描述_EN: lions were sacred animals to buddhists, so this pillow would have had a special meaning for its owner. the term cizhou encapsulates a range of wares made in several regions of northern china, often consisting of a stoneware body decorated with a bold design. ceramic pillows were an important item in the kilns producing cizhou wares, and were made for both funerary use and as a neck support for the living. this pillow is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). the stoneware body of this piece has taken on the shape of a lion through clever use of moulding and incising techniques, and brightly coloured glazes.
描述_ZN: 狮子是佛教徒的圣物，所以这个枕头对它的主人有特殊的意义。 术语 "Cizhou "概括了中国北方几个地区制造的一系列器物，通常由一个石器主体装饰着大胆的设计。 陶瓷枕头是窑厂生产的重要物品，既可用于葬礼，也可作为生活中的颈部支撑。 这个枕头是贵州器的一个例子，贵州器是中国北方地区在金代（1115-1234）时制造的一种陶瓷。 这件作品的石器主体通过巧妙地使用模压和刻画技术，以及明亮的彩色釉面，呈现出狮子的形状。
